identity.name: Drive de Cartier
identity.one_liner: The 2016 Drive de Cartier in stainless steel with the cushion case — Cartier's 2016 entry in the men's dress watch segment, designed to compete with the JLC Master Ultra Thin and the Patek Calatrava.

narrative.story: The Drive de Cartier is the 2016 men's dress watch that Cartier positioned as its "modern American" entry (the cushion case references the American car-seat-bolster design language Cartier had used in the 1920s Tank Cintrée). The 40mm stainless steel case, the 1904 MC caliber, and the small seconds at 6 are the modern specification. The Drive is the most-cited Cartier men's dress watch of the 2010s.
